metadata.actual_pbp_query: SELECT game_id, drive, posteam, play_id, play_type, yardline_100, down, pass_touchdown, rush_touchdown, interception, fumble_lost, ydstogo, series_result FROM nfl_pbp WHERE season=2024 AND week BETWEEN 2 AND 18 AND posteam IS NOT NULL AND drive IS NOT NULL ORDER BY game_id, play_id
metadata.cutoff: simulation reference eligible before 2024 Week 1; play-call artifact fit through 2023
metadata.evaluation: exploratory retrospective replay; historical schedule availability is unverified
metadata.offensive_touchdown_trip_definition: simulated drive terminal is touchdown and touchdown_scored_by equals offense_team; actual terminal series_result is exactly Touchdown (Opp touchdown is excluded)
metadata.red_zone_play_definition: run/pass scrimmage event at state/observed yardline_100 <= 20; sacks and turnovers are included in the pass/run family when the engine labels them as such
metadata.red_zone_play_touchdown_definition: simulated outcome.touchdown; actual rush_touchdown for run and pass_touchdown for pass; sampled_touchdown_flag is a source-row property and is excluded
